about_the_game:
Dive into the darkness with Prometheus, a brave soul exploring a hostile world in search of the lost light. In this demo, you will experience a fragment of the full game, facing challenges in exploration, combat, and puzzle-solving.

What’s included in this demo?

👾 Dynamic Combat: Shoot enemies to recover oxygen and collect "echoes."

🌌 Exploration and Survival: Is it too dark to see ahead? Use the light from your arrows to illuminate the path and avoid hidden dangers.

⭐ Constellation Puzzles: Find and collect 3 stars to activate a zodiac stone and solve its enigma. Your "helmet" indicates oxygen loss over time, so don’t delay—find them all!

⚡ Dash Ability: Propel yourself in any direction to dodge obstacles or reach new areas. Be careful not to fall into pits, or you'll have to start over.

Who is this demo for?

This experience is designed for fans of platformers, Metroidvania-style games, and adventures with a dark and mysterious atmosphere. If you enjoy exploration-based gameplay with survival mechanics and challenging puzzles, this demo is for you.

🎮 Controller & Keyboard Support: Play however you prefer. Using a controller is recommended.

⏳ Approximate Duration: This demo features a playable level designed for a short yet intense experience.

🔹 Note: This trial version includes limited content and does not represent the full game experience.
